verdict.rationale: Circle documents a StableFX quote API that returns executable ('tradable') or indicative ('reference') quotes between two currencies, plus settlement advances. CPN offers real-time FX quotes settled in USDC, and Circle Mint converts USD to and from USDC at no additional cost, with 1:1 redeemability. However, the fiat↔USDC Mint conversion is described as an account offering rather than a documented API, and execution and settlement-time details are thin. Missing for 10: documented fiat↔stablecoin conversion API endpoints, explicit trade-execution endpoints and fee schedules for StableFX, conversion-specific settlement-time documentation, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, conversion is a first-class API — quotes and executed conversions between fiat and stablecoins (and between stablecoins) with documented rates, fees, and settlement times

citations.quote: Creates a quote for a trade between two currencies. ... Use `type:tradable` for an executable quote

Move money near-instantly, 24/7, on programmable stablecoin rails.
